subject: Initial Order Form + MSA intake: hosting obligations, redline triage
messages:
From: Eli Torres <eli@skylineanalytics.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@skylineanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Skyline order form + MSA draft attached

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to get contracting moving so we can align on timing for a pilot. Attached are: (1) a filled order form, and (2) our internal MSA with the few edits we typically request. High level asks from my side:

- Hosting / data residency: we need clarification on where inference logs and KV cache are stored and retained.
- Availability SLOs for dedicated pools and fallback behavior to hosted.
- A short list of security artifacts (SOC2, HSM/KMS architecture) you can share with our security team.

Can you confirm who on your side should own the redline triage and whether you can surface a short table of non-negotiable terms vs. negotiables so we can fast-track procurement? We’re aiming to sign by mid-December if possible.

Attachments: Skyline_OrderForm_20261110.xlsx (Order Form), Skyline_MSA_v1_redlines.docx (redline doc)

— Eli
Eli Torres
Head of Cloud Integrations, Skyline Analytics
eli@skylineanalytics.com
+1 415 555 0198
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Eli Torres <eli@skylineanalytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Skyline order form + MSA draft attached

Eli —

Appreciate the materials. I’ll own coordination from the commercial side. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Marissa (onboarding). Quick answers up front:

- We can provide a short technical appendix on hosting/residency and the retention windows for logs and KV cache; we’ll confirm whether KV cache persists outside the GPU host (short answer: transient by default, configurable for dedicated).
- SLA: for Dedicated we publish 99.9% availability target and have a documented fallback to hosted variants; we’ll include concrete latency baselines for your expected QPS in the follow-up.
- Security artifacts: we can share our SOC2 Type II report and a high-level KMS/HSM integration diagram (redacted).

Kimberly — can you triage the attached MSA redlines and call out anything that blocks start-of-work vs. items we can accept as exceptions? Marissa — can you confirm the seat counts and expected start date from the order form?

I’ll pull together a one-page triage table by tomorrow EOD. If it helps, we can set a 30-min sync with your procurement and security folks next week.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Skyline order form + MSA draft attached

Thanks — I reviewed the attached MSA and flagged the high-priority items inline. Top-level summary:

1) Data processing / residency: Skyline requests control over log retention and a clause that would treat KV cache as "customer data" for retention purposes. We should push back: KV cache is a performance artifact and by default is ephemeral; we can offer a configurable retention option in Dedicated but cannot treat it as the same as persisted customer storage. Recommend we propose a 30‑day configurable retention as a negotiation path.

2) Indemnities & liability cap: their proposed carveouts for third‑party claims are broader than our standard. This is likely a blocker for legal acceptance without monetary cap alignment.

3) Security evidence: they requested SOC2 and an HSM architecture note. We can provide SOC2 Type II (redacted) and a short HSM/KMS integration writeup. We should avoid providing architecture diagrams that expose internal topology — provide an annotated block diagram instead.

4) Export controls & residency obligations: a few jurisdictional language asks (EU data residency language) — flag to Product/Compliance (Jonas) for residency coverage in our private offering.

Next steps: I’ll prepare a triage table: "Blockers", "Acceptable with note", "Commercial asks" — and attach a redline summary doc. Sergio — suggest we mark the indemnity wording as a negotiation item and propose a counter with a reciprocal cyber-liability carveout; also propose deadline of 2026-12-10 to resolve commercial exceptions to keep their mid-Dec timeline.

Kimberly
VP, Contracts & Privacy — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Legal - Skyline Analytics <legal@skylineanalytics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@skylineanalytics.com, eli@skylineanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Skyline order form + MSA draft attached

Kimberly / Sergio —

Thanks for the quick read. A few clarifying notes from Skyline Legal:

- On KV cache: we view the cache as containing customer-sensitive inference context. If you can offer a documented option to persist the cache only within a VPC-dedicated deployment with explicit retention controls, we can accept a carveout for Dedicated.
- Liability cap: our procurement team has limited budget and needs a higher cap for cyber incidents tied to data exfiltration — we can move on other commercial points if we can land a higher cyber carveout.
- SOC2: they accepted that you’ll provide a redacted report and a security summary.

We attached our marked MSA as well (we converted track changes to comments). A few inline asks are simple wording tweaks; others (liability, KV persistence) are material.

Proposed next steps from Skyline: 1) exchange triage table, 2) quick sync with security (20 min), 3) proposed counter to indemnity/cap. Can you share a proposed counter by EOD Friday?

Regards,
Skyline Legal
legal@skylineanalytics.com
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Eli Torres <eli@skylineanalytics.com>, Legal - Skyline Analytics <legal@skylineanalytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Skyline order form + MSA draft attached

Team — thanks for the input. Action items and plan: 

1) Kimberly to send the triage table (blockers / negotiables) by EOD today — will include proposed indemnity/cap counter and suggested 30‑day KV cache retention option for Dedicated with a note that persistent cache is only for VPC/dedicated pools.
2) Jonas to confirm residency coverage for EU/US options and whether we can commit to the specific residency language they requested for private deployment.
3) Marissa to validate seat counts and target pilot start (she flagged a 2027-01-10 earliest).
4) Sergio to prepare the commercial counter (Order Form pricing adjustments + limited cyber carveout proposal) and propose a 20-min sync for Monday 2026-11-16 at 10:00 PT.

Eli / Skyline — please confirm Monday 10:00 PT works for you and if you prefer a security-only sync ahead of that. I’ve uploaded the triage draft and our SOC2 extract here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSkylineIntake (attachments tab).

Attachments referenced: Skyline_MSA_v1_redlines.docx (Skyline redlines), SOC2_report_2026.pdf (redacted)
